text.text: A small cream-colored paper fox with ink-dot eyes folds a yellow paper boat on a rainy windowsill. When the rain softens, the fox carries the boat downstairs, sets it in a puddle by the curb, and gives it one gentle push. The boat drifts past a red bicycle and a blue mailbox as the fox watches from under a leaf umbrella.
